title: Sneaking into Lenfance as an underage teen
summary: Growing up on Canal Boulevard, Jones got into clubs as a tall teen in his father's suit and knew who played there.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Did you hang around Canal Boulevard that much?
So you knew what bands were out there, even if you were too young.
And you were that impressed by them, even before you were able to get in the places. Yeah. You'd be underage.

As I said earlier, I was lucky because I was a tall kid. Yeah. And I could get in those places. Sometimes when I was maybe 16 years old, I might be able to get past Tony at Lenfance. If he wasn't looking, I could zip in. See, I'd put one of my daddy's suits on and zip in. Now, every once in a while, Tony would decide that he was the maitre d'. I don't know if you remember Tony. I can't think of his last name. But he would come by and check the bar and spot us and throw us out. Ask us to leave. Tony didn't have to throw you out. He just asked you to leave and you left.
But I was pretty much aware of who was playing out there.
Yeah, I can remember going out to Lenfance a few times. Somehow I didn't get out there very much. It was a long way.
In those days, sure, it was a pretty good way.
I mean, if you had to go to Lenfance, I'd walk to the famous door. You'd go to the famous door in there, sure.
Sure, in those days, you caught the Canal Street streetcar and got off at the cemeteries and you transferred it to a bus.
